And everyone’s celebrating like the market just broke out.

Let me show you what I’m watching.

$773.68 was today’s daily implied range high. We’re sitting right on it at $774.

The call wall is right here at $775. That’s where the biggest wall of call positioning sits and walls like that tend to act like a ceiling.

But the level I’ve been talking about for DAYS is $779.

That’s where the 2 hour imbalance is. And guess what else is sitting right there?

The WEEKLY implied high at $779.80.

Two levels stacked on top of each other. Same damn area. That’s where I’ve said multiple times I want to be grabbing puts.

Now look DOWN. 👇

There’s a $1.48 BILLION negative gamma node sitting at $760. It’s the King node across all expirations and it’s also the put wall.

Big nodes like that act like magnets. And $755 is right below it, which is the other side of that same imbalance.

So here’s my plan:

Let it run into $779–$780.
That’s where I want puts.
$760 first, then $755.

Bulls can have their fun up here. I’m waiting for the market to come to ME.
